summary_1line: Bhima confronts the cannibal Vaka, taunts him by eating his food, and defeats the monster in a brutal wrestling fight.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima sits calmly eating the food meant for Vaka while the huge red‑haired Rakshasa storms toward him in fury through the forest.
Bhima catches a tree hurled by Vaka as both warrior and demon rip up trees and hurl them until the forest around them is stripped bare.
Bhima pins the exhausted Vaka to the ground, bends the giant demon across his knee, and breaks his back as the monster roars and spits blood.
